name: Why do doors in the Denver area start sticking when the weather changes?
description: Colorado weather can shift door fit as wood expands or contracts, especially on exterior doors.

mainEntity.name: Why do doors in the Denver area start sticking when the weather changes?

acceptedAnswer.text: For homes in Denver, Centennial, Greenwood Village, Foxfield, and Parker, weather shifts can change how doors fit, especially on exterior entries. If a door suddenly starts sticking after a cold snap or dry spell, the repair often involves small alignment changes rather than rebuilding the whole opening.
